title: Sensitivity and block sensitivity
description: OpenAI's superquadratic separation (2026): Boolean functions whose block sensitivity exceeds any constant multiple of the square of their sensitivity, answering negatively the quadratic form of the Sensitivity Conjecture. The course proves the composition and OR lemmas, a classical quadratic example, the construction of nested predicates on a randomly labelled tournament, and the sensitivity recurrences that give the separation and a fixed power larger than 2.

units.title: Nested predicates on a labelled tournament
Sensitivity recurrences and a superquadratic separation

prerequisites: core course Probability (finite probability: independence and the union bound)
